questions_and_answers.question_text: What is the useful structure with yǒu shown here?
What else does liángshi include besides grain?
Write the Chinese for "What is the area of this commune?"
Write the Chinese for "There are mainly two reasons why he doesn't want to go to China."

answers.answer_text: Tā bú yuànyi qù Zhōngguóde yuányīn zhǔyào yǒu liǎngge.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "There aren't but a few Americans who speak Chinese that well."

answers.answer_text: Zhōngwén shuōde nàme hǎode Měiguó rén méiyou jǐge.

questions_and_answers.question_text: How many large flatland regions does China have?

answers.answer_text: Four — all of them major grain-producing regions.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "China's area is 9.6 million square kilometers."

answers.answer_text: Zhōngguóde miànjī shi jiǔbǎi liùshiwàn píngfāng gōnglǐ.

articles.text:
4. A: Quánguó yígòng yǒu jǐge        How many flatland regions are there in
      píngyuán?                      the whole country?
   B: Miànjī bǐjiào dàde yǒu sìge,  There are four which are relatively
      dōu shi shēngchǎn liángshide   large in area; all of them are major
      zhǔyào dìqū.                   grain-producing regions.

Notes on No. 4

quánguó: "the whole country"

Quánguó chǎnliàng zuì gāode      The area of the country with the highest
dìqū shi Sìchuān.                output is Sìchuān.

miànjī: "(surface) area"

Zhèige gōngshède miànjī duō dà?  What is the area of this commune?
Zhōngguóde miànjī shi jiǔbǎi     China's area is 9.6 million square
liùshiwàn píngfāng gōnglǐ.       kilometers.

miànjī bǐjiào dàde yǒu sìge: This is a USEFUL STRUCTURE WITH YǑU:

Miànjī bǐjiào dàde | yǒu | sìge.
(As for the ones with a relatively large area | there are | four.)
"There are four with a relatively large area."

Tā bú yuànyi qù Zhōngguóde yuányīn | zhǔyào yǒu | liǎngge.
"There are mainly two reasons why he doesn't want to go to China."

Zuótian méi láide | yǒu | duōshao?
"How many people were there who didn't come yesterday?"

Zhōngwén shuōde nàme hǎode Měiguó rén | méiyou | jǐge.
"There aren't but a few Americans who speak Chinese that well."

liángshi: "grain, cereals" — but in Chinese terminology this can ALSO INCLUDE other staples like BEANS and SWEET POTATOES.
